introduction: South Dakota’s Helpline Center provides 211 resource help around the clock. Call, text your ZIP code or use its online directory.
description: South Dakota’s Helpline Center provides 211 resource help around the clock. Call, text your ZIP code or use its online directory.

sections.who: Anyone can request information. Each receiving program assesses eligibility for its services.
sections.get: Specialists connect people with financial assistance, food, healthcare and other community resources.

sections.apply:
1. Contact the Helpline

    Dial or text 211, email help@helplinecenter.org or use the resource links.

  2. Explain the situation

    Mention your location and providers already tried.

  3. Follow the referral

    Confirm openings, eligibility and records with the provider.
sections.after: Ask for alternatives if the referred service cannot help.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using 211 services and contact. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.
